A pair of traditional balancing scales (scales of justice) sitting on a Bible. On one side of the scale is a heavy gold coin and a royal crown; on the other side is a simple wooden bowl and a plain cloth. The scales are perfectly balanced, showing that rich and poor weigh exactly the same before God. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

A split scene comparing two modern Nigerian settings. On the left, a well-dressed man in an expensive agbada steps out of a luxury SUV, and people are rushing to bow to him and carry his briefcase. On the right, a poor man in worn-out clothes is being rudely pushed away from an office door by a security guard. A large red "X" is drawn over the entire image to show that this behaviour is wrong.
